# AgentSight

> AgentSight is an open-source, local-first profiler that connects AI agent intent and model activity to commands, processes, files, network destinations, and resource use.

Canonical site: https://agentsight.us/
Product repository: https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight
Website repository: https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight-website
Documentation: https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight#readme
Recorded demo: https://app.agentsight.us/

## Main routes

- https://agentsight.us/use-cases/
- https://agentsight.us/compare/
- https://agentsight.us/guides/
- https://agentsight.us/blog/
- https://agentsight.us/integrations/
- https://agentsight.us/security/
- https://agentsight.us/changelog/
- https://agentsight.us/releases/

## Data handling

Recorded sessions can contain prompts, responses, paths, headers, commands, and network targets. Treat raw databases and exports as sensitive and review them before sharing.
